interface.name: Harnessie CLI
interface.description: Machine-readable synopsis of the local CLI shipped by the harnessie Python package. This is not a hosted HTTP API.

global_options.--root: Project root; defaults to the current working directory.

init.purpose: Scaffold a local project and, by default, run the zero-dollar guided readiness check.
init.side_effects: Writes scaffold files below the selected project root; refuses overwrite unless --force is explicit.

run.synopsis: harnessie run WORKFLOW [--goal GOAL] [--approval-policy FILE] [--approve-interactive] [--plugin NAME ...]
run.purpose: Run a governed workflow under declared budgets, ownership, sandbox, and verification policy.
run.side_effects: Side-effecting tools remain consent and policy gated; network is denied unless a phase explicitly allows it. Plugins never auto-load; each selected in-process plugin is operator-trusted code.

resume.synopsis: harnessie resume RUN_ID WORKFLOW [--goal GOAL] [--approval-policy FILE] [--approve-interactive] [--plugin NAME ...]
resume.purpose: Resume from the audited journal while skipping already verified phases.
resume.side_effects: Uses the same consent, ownership, sandbox, budget, and verification gates as run; the exact recorded plugin receipt is required.

report.purpose: Render a plain-language local run summary and its next operator action.

audit.purpose: Verify the local event hash chain and render the governance timeline.

eval.purpose: Run deterministic scorecards; --live is a separate explicit provider opt-in.
eval.side_effects: Default suite is network-free; --live may call configured providers.

validate.purpose: Validate the six stable v1 authoring contracts and their cross-document references without starting a run.
validate.side_effects: Read-only; no model calls, network, sandbox admission, run-state creation, or workspace writes.

verify-manifest.purpose: Verify hashes in the outward public trust bundle.

verify-inward-manifest.purpose: Verify shipped prompts, configuration, and ownership policy against the inward manifest.

approve-maiden.purpose: Promote a previously staged maiden-voyage proposal after audit, ownership, artifact, and target hashes verify.
approve-maiden.side_effects: Explicit operator action that writes only the verified staged proposal to an unchanged target.

verify.synopsis: harnessie verify --workspace DIR --criteria FILE [--check CMD] [--report-dir DIR] [--models FILE] [--tier TIER] [--verifier-prompt FILE] [--no-verifier] [--allow-network] [--max-steps N]
verify.purpose: Verify a local artifact with deterministic checks followed by an optional independent verifier.
verify.side_effects: Checks are sandboxed and network-denied by default; the verifier is read-only.

governance.human_approval: Required where declared policy gates a side effect.

stability.policy: The six v1 authoring schemas and harnessie.tools.v1 plugin contract are stable for the 1.x line under SCHEMA_COMPATIBILITY.md and PLUGIN_CONTRACT.md.
